commands.title: Open File
commands.description: Open a file in the workspace's Neovim, starting it if needed, optionally at a line and column. An absolute path inside another git worktree of a workspace folder switches that folder to the worktree first and opens the file in its Neovim.

path.description: File to open; absolute, or relative to Neovim's working directory (the selected worktree of the first workspace folder that exists, else home).

line.description: 1-based line to put the cursor on; 0 or absent keeps the default position.

col.description: 1-based byte column on that line, clamped to the line length; 0 or absent puts the cursor at the line start. Ignored without line.

commands.title: Show in Quickfix
commands.description: Replace the workspace Neovim's quickfix list with the given locations, open the quickfix window and show the Code section. Returns once validated; nvim fills the list asynchronously in small batches. Takes 1 to 10000 items; only items in the first 1000 distinct files are kept, and the title then gets " (first 1000 files)". Unknown fields are rejected.

title.description: Quickfix list title, at most 512 chars without line breaks or NUL.

path.description: Absolute file path, at most 4096 bytes, without line breaks or NUL.

col.description: 1-based byte column up to 2147483647; 0 or absent for none.

text.description: Entry text, at most 512 chars, without NUL.

commands.title: Show Diff
commands.description: Open a side-by-side diff of a file between two sides in a new Neovim tab.

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside a git repo.

base.description: Left side: head, index or rev:<sha> (lowercase hex).

target.description: Right side: index, worktree or rev:<sha> (lowercase hex); must differ from base.

commands.title: Review Branch
commands.description: Open a branch review (base...head) in Neovim, with diffview when it is installed.

mode.description: diffview when a review tab was opened, otherwise builtin.

commands.title: Close Branch Review
commands.description: Close the review tab opened by editor-nvim.review; a no-op when it is gone.

commands.title: nvim Navigation Keys
commands.description: Turn on or off the Ctrl+h/j/k/l navigation that moves focus from Neovim to the clubmate sidebar (stored globally, applied to every Neovim).

skipped.description: Keys left alone because the user already maps them.

commands.title: Neovim Config
commands.description: Get the Neovim config mode and its directories, or set the mode with mode. shared runs nvim with the default config (~/.config/nvim); clubmate runs it with NVIM_APPNAME set to the app name. Running nvim instances keep their mode until restarted.

mode.description: Mode to store; absent to read the current state.

app.description: NVIM_APPNAME used in clubmate mode: clubmate, or clubmate-dev for dev builds.

configDir.description: Config dir of the app name ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/<app>).

dataDir.description: Data dir of the app name ($XDG_DATA_HOME/<app>).

sourceConfigBytes.description: Bytes of regular files in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nvim, without its .git; 0 when it is missing, -1 when unknown (unreadable, or not measured within about 1.5 s).

sourceDataBytes.description: Bytes of regular files in $XDG_DATA_HOME/nvim, without its .git; 0 when it is missing, -1 when unknown (unreadable, or not measured within about 1.5 s).

commands.title: Copy Neovim Config
commands.description: Start copying $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nvim, and with data $XDG_DATA_HOME/nvim when it exists, into the app name's dirs. Fails when a destination exists or another copy runs. Skips .git at the source root, copies symlinks as symlinks, keeps modes and skips sockets and FIFOs. Rewrites an absolute symlink pointing inside a source to the same path inside its copy. An unreadable source file aborts the copy with an error naming it; a source file that disappears meanwhile is skipped. Copies into <dest>.clubmate-tmp-* and renames into place, without replacing anything, only when every part is complete; the data dir is renamed before the config dir, and if a later rename fails the earlier ones are undone. A cancelled or failed copy leaves nothing behind, and leftover temp dirs of an interrupted copy are removed when the plugin starts. Destinations on network filesystems that lack exclusive rename fail at the rename.

data.description: Also copy the data dir (plugins, lazy, mason).

id.description: Copy id for config-copy-status and config-copy-cancel.

commands.title: Neovim Config Copy Status
commands.description: Progress of a config copy. Waits up to 1 s for the copy to finish before replying. Fails for an unknown id; the last copy stays known until the next one starts.

total.description: Bytes to copy; 0 until the sources are measured.

done.description: Whether the copy has ended and its temp dirs are gone.

error.description: Why it failed, or cancelled; absent on success.

commands.title: Cancel Neovim Config Copy
commands.description: Cancel a config copy; config-copy-status then reports done with error cancelled once its temp dirs are removed. A no-op for a finished copy.

commands.title: Stop Worktree Neovim
commands.description: Stop the workspace's Neovim whose root is the given path and keep it from starting there again until editor-nvim.release-root. Fails like restart while it has unsaved buffers, unless force is true. Only marks the root when no such Neovim exists.

root.description: Absolute root path of the Neovim, as listed in the workspace roots.

force.description: Stop even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.

commands.title: Release Worktree Neovim
commands.description: End a stop-root: Neovim may start in the given root again, and starts now when it is still the workspace's current root.

root.description: Absolute root path passed to stop-root.

commands.title: Reveal File in Finder
commands.description: Reveal the file currently open in Neovim in Finder.

commands.title: Open Terminal Here
commands.description: Open a new terminal in the directory of the file open in Neovim, or in the first workspace folder.

commands.title: Restart Neovim
commands.description: Restart every running Neovim of the workspace (one per worktree). Fails while file buffers in any of them have unsaved changes, or while a running Neovim does not answer (unsaved buffers: unknown), unless force is true.

force.description: Restart even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.
